title: deployment-failure-triager inputs
description: Exactly one evidence source is required: job_id or result_path. Do not guess a job id.

job_id.description: Existing Metadata API deploy id. Required for live retrieve. Never use --use-most-recent.

target_org_alias.description: sf CLI alias for live retrieve. Optional if result_path is set.

result_path.description: Path to sf project deploy report --json output (fixture or CI).

source_path.description: Salesforce DX project root for local file mapping.
